title: IVG Savr 3000 Mango Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Mango IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods deliver a bright, tropical Mango flavour with notes of soft peachiness and golden sweetness. This profile offers an easy all-day vape with a clean, fruity finish that fans of ripe exotic blends will appreciate. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a connected 4ml refill reservoir. Once clicked together and inserted into the IVG Savr 3000 device, the pod is automatically topped up as you vape — no manual refilling, no coil swaps. The pod uses mesh coil technology to ensure consistent flavour delivery and smooth MTL vapour. Compatible only with the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
